summary: Interactive Strength filed an 8-K disclosing an exchange agreement dated September 30, 2026 with holders of unsecured convertible Remainder Notes issued under June 2025 master netting arrangements. The company swapped $7,685,090 of outstanding principal, interest and other obligations for 768,509 newly designated Series R Convertible Preferred shares under Section 3(a)(9), cancelling the notes at closing and reimbursing $50,000 of holder legal fees. The Series R shares are immediately convertible, with the company required to reserve 100% of underlying common shares and call a shareholder meeting if authorized shares are insufficient. A liability-management exchange, not a change-of-control event.
